description: Schema for aco_metadata — Adobe Commerce Optimizer (ACO) catalog attribute metadata. Each array item matches the ACO API wire format (camelCase). Top-level API parameters (e.g. data_type on the request) remain snake_case.

source.description: Source of the entity (required), e.g. catalog locale

visibleIn.description: Where the attribute is visible on the storefront (required). PRODUCT_DETAIL: Product Detail Page. PRODUCT_LISTING: Product Listing Page. SEARCH_RESULTS: Search Results Page. PRODUCT_COMPARE: Product Compare Page.

searchTypes.description: Search behaviors for this attribute (required; may be empty). AUTOCOMPLETE, CONTAINS, STARTS_WITH.

filterable.description: Whether the attribute can filter products

sortable.description: Whether the attribute can sort products

searchable.description: Whether the attribute can be used in search

searchWeight.description: Weight for searchable attributes (higher returned first)
